selectionRule: First three W0 members sorted by mergedAt ascending then number ascending; no content or outcome filtering.
stopRules: Stop the entire run immediately on HTTP 401, 403, 429 or a rate-limit diagnostic.
Do not switch authentication, transport, endpoint families or credentials after a denial.
Stop on any capture failure; retain selected but unattempted rows and unknown fields.
No new discovery or W1/W2 source, diff, discussion, labels or model-output reads.
transport: Existing captureGithubPrEvidence default unauthenticated official Octokit GET-only transport; no credential copying or transport substitution.
sourceScope: Selected W0 PR changed paths at provider-declared merge-base/head plus PR discussion; no target code execution.
license: If capture succeeds, retrieve license only at a selected pinned W0 head with remaining budget; preserve provenance and mark redistribution pending until license established.
limitations: Current API observation, not historical review checkpoint.
PR baseTip can reflect current branch state; mergeBase/head define changed source.
No independent human labels, rule mining, models, or efficacy measurements.
Unsuccessful acquisition is retained, not replaced by another PR.
